sub-agent indicator"},{"id":"p28s14","text":" with cancel/remove controls.

folder completion, direct `!` shell mode, inline selectors, and
keyboard-first navigation.

- **Adaptive visuals** — a DeepSeek-blue pal"},{"id":"p28s18","text":"ette tuned independently for dark
